title: Knit Off-the-shoulder Sleeve Bodycon Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this sultry knit bodycon evening dress! Featuring an off-the-shoulder neckline and sleek, curve-hugging silhouette, this dress is perfect for formal events or glamorous nights out. Effortlessly chic and undeniably captivating!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, without lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
